title: A measurement noise scaling law for cellular representation learning
zh_title: 细胞表征学习的测量噪声缩放定律
summary: 以辅助信号互信息衡量表征模型表现，拟合2000余个模型，覆盖基因表达、序列与图像，发现性能随噪声呈对数缩放。

abstract: Large genomic and imaging datasets can be used to train models that learn meaningful representations of cellular systems. Across domains, model performance improves predictably with dataset size and compute budget, providing a basis for allocating data and computation. Scientific data, however, are also limited by noise arising from factors such as molecular undersampling, sequencing errors and image resolution. Here we introduce mutual information with auxiliary signals as a metric of representation model performance and study its scaling with noise. By fitting more than 2,000 representation learning models across three data modalities (gene expression, sequence and image data), we show that noise defines a distinct axis along which performance improves. Noise scaling follows a logarithmic law. We derive the law from a model of noise propagation, and use it to define noise sensitivity and model capacity as benchmarking metrics. We show that protein-sequence representations tolerate error rates in modern sequencing data, whereas single-cell transcriptomic models remain noise limited at current measurement signal-to-noise ratio levels. Within transcriptomic cell-state representation learning models, we find that transformer-based models are more noise robust but less performant than variational autoencoders. Noise scaling metrics may support future model evaluation and experimental design.
zh_abstract: 大型基因组和影像数据集可用于训练能够学习细胞系统有意义表征的模型。在各个领域中，模型性能均随数据集规模和计算预算而可预测地提升，这为数据和计算资源的分配提供了依据。然而，科学数据同样受到噪声的限制，噪声来源包括分子欠采样、测序错误和图像分辨率等因素。在此，我们提出以与辅助信号的互信息作为表征模型性能的指标，并研究其随噪声的缩放规律。通过在三种数据模态（基因表达、序列和图像数据）上拟合 2,000 多个表征学习模型，我们表明噪声定义了一条性能得以提升的独立轴线。噪声缩放遵循对数规律。我们从噪声传播模型推导出该规律，并据此定义噪声敏感性和模型容量，作为基准评测指标。我们表明，蛋白质序列表征可耐受现代测序数据中的错误率，而单细胞转录组模型在当前测量信噪比水平下仍受噪声限制。在转录组细胞状态表征学习模型中，我们发现基于 Transformer 的模型噪声鲁棒性更强，但性能不及变分自编码器。噪声缩放指标可能有助于未来的模型评估和实验设计。

abstract: The silicon microelectrode ‘Utah’ array has enabled people with paralysis to control computer cursors, operate prosthetic limbs and communicate using high-performance brain–computer interfaces. However, reports so far have typically been limited to one or two individuals, with no systematic assessment of array longevity, decoding accuracy and day-to-day stability. Here we present a comprehensive 20-year evaluation of neural data from the BrainGate clinical trials, spanning 2,289 recording sessions, 20 arrays and 14 participants. On average, arrays successfully recorded neural spiking waveforms on 35.6% of electrodes, with a modest 7 percentage point decline over the recording period (up to 7.3 years). Using a ‘decoding signal-to-noise ratio’ (dSNR) metric, we found that 11 of 14 arrays provided meaningful movement decoding throughout participation (median dSNR >1), with three achieving >70% accuracy compared with able-bodied mouse control. We also found that dSNR increased approximately logarithmically with the number of electrodes, providing a pathway for scaling performance. While longevity exceeded previous nonhuman primate studies, achieving peak performance consistently may require further improvements.

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To understand how rural hospitals use artificial intelligence (AI) and identify ways to reduce the barriers to safe, effective use of high-quality tools that align with these hospitals' key priorities. Stratified random sample drawn from the full population of critical access hospitals (CAHs) in the United States in 2025 (n = 1377) to approximate proportional representation of the 4 census regions. We conducted in-depth qualitative interviews with hospital leadership (eg, CMIOs, CIOs, IT leads) tasked with decision-making about technology. Interviews were conducted between October 20, 2025, and January 23, 2026. Drawn from the full population of CAHs in the US in 2025, 256 hospitals were sampled and interviews were completed for a total of 50 CAHs represented by 73 interview participants. Generative AI applications were more common and seen as more valuable for CAH contexts than traditional predictive AI. Primary barriers included infrastructure limitations, cost, and lack of transparency on how AI tools worked. Despite a desire to implement robust governance, most CAHs did not have the ability to do so and reported a critical need for information, tools, and policies to build their AI governance capacity. Information (peer learning, information from non-commercial sources), tools (registries, model cards), and policy to support technical capacity were perceived as the most responsive ways to build capacity. To reduce structural barriers to safe and effective AI decision-making, resources and investment should focus on information sharing with and across rural organizations, AI governance support, and transparency efforts. This will support CAHs in judiciously leveraging available resources and prevent waste on low-quality or misaligned AI tools.

abstract: [Gastric cancer : official journal of the International Gastric Cancer Association and the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association] Selecting adjuvant chemotherapy for gastric cancer requires balancing tumor risk and patient-related factors. We developed and internally validated a recurrent deep survival machine (RDSM) framework to evaluate whether concordance with AI-recommended treatment is associated with overall survival (OS). This retrospective cohort study analyzed 15,848 patients with stage II-III gastric cancer from the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association (2011, 2013). Patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy, non-standard regimens, or dying within 8 weeks post-surgery were excluded. Patients were categorized as AI-recommended or AI-non-recommended based on whether their treatment matched the model-derived recommendation (the regimen with the highest predicted 5-year survival probability). Primary outcome was 5-year OS. Model performance was evaluated using the concordance index (C-index), and multiple imputation with propensity score overlap weighting (MI-OW) was used for the observational comparison of treatment concordance. RDSM showed superior discrimination compared with the Cox model (C-index, 0.77 vs. 0.73). After MI-OW, concordance with AI-recommended treatment was associated with higher 5-year OS than discordance (74.00% vs. 66.16%; adjusted difference, 7.84 percentage points [95% CI, 6.06-9.62]). A similar association was observed among patients aged ≥ 75 years (64.18% vs. 52.76%; adjusted difference, 11.42 percentage points [95% CI, 6.72-16.12]). These associations are not causal treatment effects. SHAP analyses highlighted patient-related factors for S-1 monotherapy and tumor burden for S-1 plus oxaliplatin. RDSM identified model-derived treatment patterns associated with observed OS differences, without establishing benefits from AI-guided treatment changes. External validation and prospective evaluation are needed before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Gastric cancer : official journal of the International Gastric Cancer Association and the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association] 胃癌辅助化疗的选择需要在肿瘤风险与患者相关因素之间取得平衡。我们开发并进行了内部验证循环深度生存机（recurrent deep survival machine，RDSM）框架，以评估与AI推荐治疗的一致性是否与总生存期（OS）相关。这项回顾性队列研究分析了来自日本胃癌学会（2011年、2013年）的15,848例 II–III 期胃癌患者。接受新辅助治疗、非标准方案或术后8周内死亡的患者被排除。根据患者的治疗是否与模型得出的推荐（预测5年生存概率最高的方案）相符，将其分为AI推荐组或非AI推荐组。主要结局为5年OS。采用一致性指数（C-index）评估模型性能，并采用多重插补结合倾向评分重叠加权（MI-OW）对治疗一致性进行观察性比较。RDSM 的区分能力优于 Cox 模型（C-index，0.77 对 0.73）。经 MI-OW 后，与AI推荐治疗一致者的5年OS高于不一致者（74.00% 对 66.16%；校正差值 7.84 个百分点 [95% CI，6.06–9.62]）。在年龄≥75岁的患者中观察到类似的关联（64.18% 对 52.76%；校正差值 11.42 个百分点 [95% CI，6.72–16.12]）。这些关联并非因果性治疗效应。SHAP 分析显示，S-1 单药治疗主要与患者相关因素有关，而 S-1 联合奥沙利铂主要与肿瘤负荷有关。RDSM 识别出了与观察到的OS差异相关的模型推导治疗模式，但并未证实AI指导下改变治疗会带来获益。在临床应用之前，需要进行外部验证和前瞻性评估。

abstract: [Journal of medicinal chemistry] Bridging structural discontinuities between disparate protein families is a fundamental challenge in multi-target design. We present a generative artificial intelligence (AI) platform for the non-linear interpolation of cross-family kinase space to simultaneously modulate innate (interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4, IRAK4) and adaptive (tyrosine kinase 2, TYK2) immunity. Utilizing a variational autoencoder-recurrent neural network (VAE-RNN) model within the POLYGON framework, we successfully navigated high-dimensional latent space through an iterative "sampling-scoring-refocusing" strategy. This approach bypassed the geometric limitations of traditional pharmacophore merging, leading to the rational discovery of a novel spirocyclic scaffold with significant structural novelty (Tanimoto similarity <0.45). Integration of WaterMap-based optimization and proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) conjugation yielded C-8-014, a potent dual-target degrader achieving nanomolar potency and efficient degradation of both kinases. This study demonstrates a validated closed-loop methodology for navigating "unreachable" regions of the kinome, providing a paradigm-shifting approach for cross-family chemical design and a powerful molecular tool for chemical biology.

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to extract information from electronic health records (EHRs). Given the rapid pace of LLM development, robust scenario-specific benchmarks are essential to evaluate clinical usefulness and support safe deployment. This study aimed to compare contemporary LLMs for structured data extraction from real neurosurgical EHRs written in Czech. In a prospective single-center cohort, 172 hospitalized patients provided informed consent for the use of anonymized EHRs. For each patient, predefined records were collected and concatenated. Ground truth for 35 data points was established by dual extraction with consensus. A standardized prompt requesting JSON output was submitted to 19 LLMs. The primary outcome was overall accuracy; secondary outcomes were category-level accuracy and the proportion of complete machine-readable outputs. A total of 6264 documents were collected (median 33, IQR 25-41 per patient). Ground truth was established with 92.6% initial interrater agreement before consensus. Several models produced complete JSON outputs for 100% of cases (Claude 4.1 Opus, Grok 4, and Gemini 2.5 Flash); GPT-4.1 (DeepSearch) and GPT-5 completed 99.4%. The highest accuracy was achieved by GPT-4.1 (87.6%), followed by GPT-4.5 (85.6%), Claude 4.1 (84.8%), and Grok 4 (84.2%). Accuracy declined by data type: binary (up to 95%), numeric (~89%), multiple-choice (~75%), and short text (~78%). Current LLMs can reliably extract structured clinical information from full, non-English EHRs, while older or smaller models show major limitations. A hybrid workflow-automated extraction with targeted validation-appears practical for research use.

abstract: Tumor evolution in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) drives drug resistance and disease progression, yet the cellular transitions underlying the malignant transformation of cells remain poorly understood. Comparing this progression of cancer cells across patients is challenging owing to substantial inter-patient cell heterogeneity. Here, based on single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) data of 227 patients with LUAD including 422,727 tumor cells, we conducted a comprehensive investigation of tumor cell progression and developed Global Tumor Time (GTT), a continuous measure of tumor cell progression across patients. GTT provided a scalable and biologically meaningful metric of tumor progression that aligned with clinicopathological, transcriptomic and spatial characteristics of malignancy and demonstrated robust prognostic performance (C-index = 0.60), which was further validated in two external datasets comprising snRNA-seq (C-index = 0.66) and bulk RNA sequencing (C-index = 0.61). Using explainable AI to investigate the molecular correlates of GTT, we identified two distinct transcriptional programs associated with early and late progression states. These findings establish a scalable and interpretable framework for reconstructing malignant cell transformation across patients and allow for investigating the biology of tumor progression at single-cell resolution.

abstract: RNA function depends on interactions between nucleotides that can be widely separated in sequence, yet capturing these relationships remains challenging for RNA language models. Existing approaches primarily learn nucleotide relationships implicitly from individual nucleotide reconstruction or rely on external structural information to model nucleotide interactions. Here we introduce RIPPLE, an RNA foundation model that learns to identify and represent sparse, predictively useful nucleotide relationships directly from sequence. Pretrained on 32.4 million RNA sequences, RIPPLE uses pairwise predictive utility to guide relational learning, transferring training-time supervision into a sequence-only model without requiring structural inputs at inference. RIPPLE improves overall performance across five downstream tasks spanning RNA family classification, ribosome loading prediction, secondary-structure prediction, three-dimensional contact prediction, and splice-site recognition. Mechanistic analyses further show that utility-guided learning improves the recovery of informative interactions and enhances the transferability of learned RNA representations.

abstract: [Journal of personalized medicine] Heart failure affects more than 64 million people worldwide and remains associated with high mortality and recurrent hospitalisation. Artificial intelligence (AI), including large language models (LLMs), is being evaluated across the care pathway, but evidence maturity varies by task. The aim of this narrative review was to appraise direct evidence for LLM applications in heart failure, distinguish it from supporting evidence for other AI methods and propose a risk-based framework for clinical evaluation and governance. The strongest direct LLM evidence concerns electronic health record extraction, document drafting, patient information and clinical trial endpoint adjudication. A small, randomised pilot evaluated supervised generative-AI-guided optimisation of guideline-directed medical therapy. Prospective case-finding and monitoring evidence largely concerns non-LLM AI. For conversational AI telemonitoring (a natural language interface with rule-based alerting), prospective evidence was limited to a single non-randomised controlled pilot. Performance depends on task definition, data completeness, human review and workflow adoption. Overall, LLMs can support clearly defined, supervised heart failure tasks, but current evidence does not justify autonomous high-stakes care. The evidence base is expanding but predominantly retrospective. Prospective trials, disease-specific benchmarks, equity assessment and regulatory engagement are prerequisites for safe clinical translation. Human oversight remains essential across all current-generation applications.

abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Creatinine, estimated glomerular filtration rate and histology detect kidney disease late and say little about the molecular heterogeneity driving progression. Artificial intelligence can extract molecular features from biofluid omics; digitised biopsies and retinal images supply proxy readouts, not molecular measurements. In this review we grouped the literature by histopathology, multi-omics, foundation models and noninvasive systems and checked each result against its cohort, endpoint and validation setting. Reported performance is often high, but most results come from retrospective single-cohort evaluations; external and prospective validation are uncommon, and we found no study among those reviewed showing improved patient outcomes. High discrimination therefore establishes technical performance only; clinical utility and patient benefit remain untested. The evidence to date supports feasibility, not benefit, and the weakness lies in evaluation design rather than model architecture. The evidence so far establishes feasibility, not benefit. abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is highly prominent in computational drug-drug interaction (DDI) research, yet adoption in real development and regulatory workflows lags publication volume. This gap reflects a mismatch between benchmark-driven method development and the decisions that DDI assessment supports. We synthesize the AI methodology landscape - from shallow learning to large language models - and integrate it with physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling, static models, and regulatory guidance (ICH M12); the literature was identified via structured PubMed/MEDLINE searches (2012-2026, prioritizing 2018-2026). We propose a task-, stage-, and mechanism-specific framework in which pharmacokinetic (PK) change is an upstream surrogate whose clinical relevance is set by downstream pharmacodynamic and adverse-event outcomes. AI's practical strengths now lie in triage, parameter priors, and workflow acceleration rather than replacing mechanistic reasoning. Two caveats merit emphasis: large language models must not serve as standalone DDI prediction engines, and retrospective benchmark accuracy is no substitute for prospective, decision-oriented validation. The field should move from model novelty to fit-for-purpose, non-leaky benchmarks; interaction-strength-dependent, calibration-based evaluation; decomposed uncertainty; and prospective workflow-embedded validation.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from stand-alone accuracy studies to prospective deployment across breast screening, risk prediction, multimodal diagnosis, treatment response, and workflow support. The goal of this narrative review is to determine which AI applications have demonstrated clinical benefit, which remain technically promising, and what safeguards are required for implementation. We synthesize randomized trials, prospective cohorts, real-world implementations, external validations, systematic reviews, and guidance identified in PubMed/MEDLINE and Scopus through 30 June 2026. In screening, AI-supported mammography can increase cancer detection and reduce reading workload, but effects depend on whether AI is used as concurrent support, an independent reader, triage, or partial autonomy; autonomous workflows may shift work and cost downstream through additional recalls. MASAI met its prespecified noninferiority criterion for interval cancer, but this should not be interpreted as proof of equivalence or mortality benefit. Image-based risk models often discriminate better than density or conventional clinical models, although prospective benefit from AI-guided allocation to supplemental imaging has not yet been demonstrated. Evidence for contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM), MRI, ultrasound, radiomics, and multimodal models is less mature and limited by external validation, domain shift, missing data, operator dependence, and uncertain incremental value beyond clinicopathological factors. Ungrounded large language models and opaque foundation models are not suitable for autonomous clinical advice. Current evidence therefore supports controlled, task-specific integration rather than radiologist replacement; real clinical benefit depends on governance of the whole AI-enabled pathway, including local validation, human factors, downstream resource use, statistical stopping rules, and fallback procedures.

abstract: [Molecular imaging] Accurate segmentation of metabolically active lymphoma on whole-body 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT) is important for prognosis and treatment planning. Conventional methods show substantial variability, whereas deep learning (DL) offers improved automation but limited multicenter generalizability. To compare classical and AI-based segmentation approaches and assess their clinical performance, reproducibility, and potential for precision oncology. A structured search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Google Scholar (1990-2025) identified studies on lymphoma segmentation using manual, threshold-based, region-growing, clustering, atlas-based, or DL methods. Outcomes included Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), reproducibility, and prognostic relevance. A total of 73 studies were included in the final analysis. Threshold-based methods were simple but inconsistent. Region-based approaches achieved DSCs of approximately 0.80-0.84, while clustering methods reached about 0.87. Atlas-based techniques improved physiologic uptake exclusion but often required expert review. DL models, particularly U-Net and V-Net variants, achieved DSCs of approximately 0.75-0.88 and approached expert-level performance. Hybrid PET/CT and longitudinal models further improved segmentation accuracy. AI-based segmentation offers scalable and reproducible lymphoma burden assessment. Key challenges remain multicenter generalizability, small-lesion detection, and explainability, highlighting the need for harmonized datasets and clinically oriented validation.

abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide despite major therapeutic advances, including immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Although a subset of patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) experiences durable long-term responses, currently available predictive biomarkers, including programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) expression, have limited ability to reliably distinguish responders from non-responders. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have emerged as powerful approaches for extracting clinically meaningful patterns from complex, high-dimensional datasets spanning pathology, liquid biopsy, imaging, and integrated multimodal data. This narrative review examines current applications of AI in NSCLC immunotherapy across these complementary data modalities and evaluates the evidence supporting their clinical translation. Particular attention is given to the methodological limitations of existing studies and to the emerging shift from single-modality biomarkers toward dynamic and multimodal prediction. Although AI-based approaches show potential to complement established biomarkers, limitations in validation, generalizability, and prospective evidence currently restrict their clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 尽管包括免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）在内的治疗取得重大进展，肺癌仍是全球癌症相关死亡的首要原因。虽然一部分晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者可获得持久的长期缓解，但包括程序性死亡配体-1（PD-L1）表达在内的现有预测性生物标志物，可靠区分应答者与非应答者的能力有限。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）已成为从涵盖病理、液体活检、影像及整合多模态数据的复杂高维数据集中提取具有临床意义模式的有力方法。本叙述性综述考察了AI在NSCLC免疫治疗中跨这些互补数据模态的现有应用，并评估支持其临床转化的证据。文中特别关注现有研究的方法学局限，以及从单一模态生物标志物向动态和多模态预测转变的新趋势。尽管基于AI的方法显示出补充既有生物标志物的潜力，但在验证、泛化能力和前瞻性证据方面的不足目前限制了其临床应用。

title: The Translation Gap in Artificial Intelligence-Based Renal Mass Characterization: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI肾脏肿块characterization的转化鸿沟：叙述综述
summary: 综述指出AI肾脏肿块定性模型虽在多中心及部分前瞻测试集表现良好，但独立验证、对管理或结局影响及监管证据仍有限。
key_points: 验证多基于切除并病理确诊的肿块，小病灶代表不足
RenalCLIP、MPANet等多中心模型仍为回顾性
四项回顾性读者实验显示辅助或提升准确性，未测量结局
reason: 综述上限6档；含读者研究与转化证据评述
abstract: [Cancers] Artificial intelligence (AI) models for solid renal mass characterization show promising discrimination in multicenter and some prospective test sets, yet little published evidence supports their routine clinical use. We examine four translation gaps. Independent, representative validation remains limited, and most studies use resected, pathologically confirmed masses, underrepresenting small indeterminate lesions managed by biopsy or surveillance. Recent multicenter models, including RenalCLIP and MPANet, broadened tasks and external testing but remain retrospective. Four retrospective reader experiments suggest that AI assistance can improve readers' accuracy or consistency, but no study identified measured effects on management or patient outcomes. Regulatory evidence is limited: one renal tool reported by its manufacturer as certified under the European Union Medical Device Regulation rests on a single-center retrospective reader study of detection and reporting, and no characterization device was identified in the U.S. Food and Drug Administration AI-enabled device list. The 2026 European Association of Urology guidelines discuss AI as an emerging technology without a graded recommendation. Cost, information technology integration, trust, and interpretability further restrict adoption. We propose a roadmap built around one intended use, the small indeterminate solid mass considered for biopsy or surveillance, with prespecified thresholds, target-specific reference standards, and paired management and safety endpoints.

title: BYSTER: multimodal graph learning resolves bystander versus tumor-specific T cell states in the tumor immune microenvironment
zh_title: BYSTER：多模态图学习区分旁观者与肿瘤特异性T细胞
summary: 预印本提出异质图神经网络BYSTER，整合转录与配对TCR表示，在三个数据集上AUROC为0.729至0.920，优于单模态与常规多模态基线。
key_points: 跨模态消息传递，在metacell/metaTCR层面整合
三个数据集平均AUROC 0.729–0.920
消融实验支持跨模态传递的贡献
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限；单细胞肿瘤免疫方向
abstract: Bystander T cells infiltrate tumors without recognizing tumor antigens and constitute a substantial component of the tumor microenvironment. Whether they are passive residents or active participants in antitumor immunity, and how they influence immunotherapy response, remains poorly understood, largely because transcriptional states and T-cell receptor (TCR) sequences alone do not reliably resolve antigen specificity. Here, we developed BYSTER, a heterogeneous graph neural network that integrates transcriptional representations with paired TCR representations through cross-modal message passing at metacell and metaTCR resolution. Across three datasets with distinct definitions of tumor specificity, BYSTER achieved mean AUROCs of 0.729 to 0.920, outperforming unimodal and conventional multimodal baselines, and ablation analyses confirmed the contribution of cross-modal message passing. Application to lung and pancreatic cancer cohorts revealed distinct biological characteristics of the two predicted populations. Bystander T cells were enriched for naive and memory subsets and MAIT-like cells expressing SLC4A10, and exhibited inflammatory and cellular stress-associated programs, including TNF signaling via NF-{kappa}B and hypoxia. Notably, these transcriptional patterns were consistent across lung and pancreatic cancers, with tumor-specific T cells showing enrichment of cell cycle and proliferation-associated programs in both cancer types. Spatial analyses further revealed distinct inferred communication patterns, with bystander T cells showing associations with inflammatory ligand-receptor interactions involving myeloid populations. Responders to immunotherapy contributed a larger proportion of the predicted bystander compartment, suggesting an association between bystander T-cell abundance and an immune-responsive microenvironment. BYSTER thus links predicted T-cell antigen specificity to transcriptional states, spatial organization and clinical response, highlighting the potential importance of bystander T cells in tumor immunity.
zh_abstract: 旁观者T细胞浸润肿瘤但不识别肿瘤抗原，是肿瘤微环境的重要组成部分。它们究竟是被动的驻留者还是抗肿瘤免疫的积极参与者，以及如何影响免疫治疗应答，目前仍知之甚少，主要原因在于仅凭转录状态和T细胞受体（TCR）序列无法可靠地解析抗原特异性。在此，我们开发了BYSTER，这是一种异质图神经网络，通过在metacell和metaTCR分辨率上进行跨模态消息传递，整合转录表征与配对TCR表征。在三个对肿瘤特异性定义不同的数据集中，BYSTER的平均AUROC为0.729至0.920，优于单模态和传统多模态基线，消融分析证实了跨模态消息传递的贡献。将其应用于肺癌和胰腺癌队列，揭示了两类预测群体具有不同的生物学特征。旁观者T细胞富集于初始（naive）和记忆亚群以及表达SLC4A10的MAIT样细胞，并表现出炎症和细胞应激相关程序，包括通过NF-κB的TNF信号通路和缺氧。值得注意的是，这些转录模式在肺癌和胰腺癌中一致，而肿瘤特异性T细胞在两种癌症中均表现为细胞周期和增殖相关程序的富集。空间分析进一步揭示了不同的推断通讯模式，旁观者T细胞与涉及髓系细胞群的炎症性配体-受体相互作用相关。免疫治疗应答者在预测的旁观者细胞部分中占比更大，提示旁观者T细胞丰度与免疫应答性微环境之间存在关联。因此，BYSTER将预测的T细胞抗原特异性与转录状态、空间组织和临床应答联系起来，凸显了旁观者T细胞在肿瘤免疫中的潜在重要性。

title: Auditable AI agents for verifiable end-to-end scientific analysis
zh_title: 面向可验证端到端科学分析的可审计AI智能体
summary: 预印本提出以可审计性为核心的科学自动化范式，并在病毒进化分析中实现EvoTrace智能体。
key_points: 四项原则：知识落地、有界执行、证据支撑、独立验证
整理13条原则、236个陷阱、50个分析单元
验证其中47项并构成六层体系
reason: AI for scientific discovery方向，新意明确但证据有限
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are evolving from research assistants into end-to-end executors, yet their capacity to generate conclusions at scale outpaces rigorous verification. Here we introduce an auditability-centred paradigm for scientific automation, wherein trust relies not on generative capability or self-evaluation, but on whether claims can be independently traced to primary evidence, reviewed and corrected. Moving beyond post-hoc checks, we embed verification throughout the research lifecycle via four principles: grounded knowledge, bounded execution, evidence-backed results and independent verification. We instantiate this paradigm in EvoTrace for viral evolutionary analysis. Distilling peer-review critiques and methodological literature, we curated 13 principles, 236 pitfalls and 50 analytical units - validating 47 across a six-tier hierarchy - to encode methodological limits as executable constraints. Across simulated benchmarks, six viral datasets and an end-to-end Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) study, claim-evidence auditing compiled evidence packages for all 233 analyses (flagging 26 incomplete evidentiary chains), while independent numerical and figure audits rectified 17 flaws, including three blocker-level errors. For CCHFV, EvoTrace intercepted a data-contradictory claim, recalibrating 'no reassortment candidates' to 'no high-confidence candidates'. By co-delivering verification evidence, auditable automation shifts AI-driven science from autonomous generation to continuous scrutiny and correction.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）智能体正从研究助手演变为端到端执行者，但其大规模生成结论的能力超过了严格验证的速度。在此我们提出一种以可审计性为核心的科学自动化范式：信任并不依赖于生成能力或自我评估，而取决于结论能否被独立追溯到原始证据、接受审查并得到纠正。我们不再局限于事后检查，而是通过四项原则将验证贯穿整个研究生命周期：有据可依的知识、有界的执行、有证据支持的结果和独立验证。我们在用于病毒进化分析的EvoTrace中实现了这一范式。通过提炼同行评审意见和方法学文献，我们整理出13项原则、236个陷阱和50个分析单元（其中47个在六层级体系中经过验证），将方法学局限编码为可执行的约束。在模拟基准、六个病毒数据集以及一项端到端克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒（CCHFV）研究中，结论-证据审计为全部233项分析编制了证据包（标记出26条不完整的证据链），而独立的数值与图表审计纠正了17处缺陷，其中包括三处阻断级错误。在CCHFV研究中，EvoTrace拦截了一条与数据相矛盾的结论，将“无重配候选”重新校准为“无高置信度候选”。通过同步提供验证证据，可审计自动化使AI驱动的科学从自主生成转向持续的审查与纠正。

title: RepurposeAD: Knowledge Graph-Guided LLM Reasoning for Alzheimer's Drug Repurposing.
zh_title: RepurposeAD：知识图谱引导LLM推理的阿尔茨海默病药物重定位
summary: 提出RepurposeAD框架，整合蛋白互作、药靶、临床试验与转录组知识图谱，引导LLM对AD重定位候选药物进行推理与排序。
key_points: 构建以AD为中心的统一知识图谱
融合转录组与药理学证据于单一推理流程
旨在提升机制透明度，摘要未见验证细节
reason: 新方法的药物重定位与AD方向，摘要缺验证信息，属值得一看档
abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Alzheimer's disease (AD) drug development continues to suffer from high late-stage attrition and narrow mechanistic diversity, which makes the systematic repurposing of approved compounds an urgent priority. Existing computational repurposing methods operate on fragmented biomedical knowledge, rarely integrate transcriptomic and pharmacological evidence within a single reasoning process, and provide little of the mechanistic transparency required for clinical translation. This paper presents RepurposeAD, a knowledge graph-guided large language model (LLM) reasoning framework that identifies and ranks repurposed candidates for AD. Methods: RepurposeAD constructs a unified AD-centric knowledge graph from protein interaction networks, drug-target databases, clinical trial registries, and transcriptomic signatures, linking genetic risk loci, amyloid and tau pathway nodes, neuroinflammatory mediators, and established therapeutic mechanisms. A constrained multi-hop path reasoning module scores drug-to-disease routes and attributes each route to one of five pathological axes, after which an LLM-based evidence synthesis module reads the retrieved paths, trial records, and literature to produce calibrated mechanistic justifications and a final iterative re-ranking. Results: On a curated benchmark of 1847 drug-disease associations spanning amyloid, tau, neuroinflammatory, synaptic, and metabolic targets, RepurposeAD attains a top-10 hit rate of 0.83, an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.79, an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.93, and a mean reciprocal rank of 0.65, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 0.07 in hit rate and 0.08 in precision-recall area. Three of the ten highest ranked candidates have active or completed trials in AD-adjacent indications. Conclusions: RepurposeAD provides a transparent, scalable, and mechanistically grounded pipeline for accelerating repurposing in AD and related dementias.
zh_abstract: [药学(Pharmaceuticals)] 【背景/目的】阿尔茨海默病(AD)药物研发持续面临后期高淘汰率和机制多样性狭窄的问题，因此对已获批化合物进行系统性重新定位已成为当务之急。现有的计算性药物重新定位方法基于碎片化的生物医学知识，很少在单一推理过程中整合转录组学和药理学证据，也几乎不提供临床转化所需的机制透明性。本文提出RepurposeAD，一个由知识图谱引导的大语言模型(LLM)推理框架，用于识别并排序AD的重新定位候选药物。【方法】RepurposeAD从蛋白质相互作用网络、药物靶点数据库、临床试验注册库和转录组学特征中构建统一的以AD为中心的知识图谱，连接遗传风险位点、淀粉样蛋白和tau蛋白通路节点、神经炎症介质以及已确立的治疗机制。一个受约束的多跳路径推理模块对药物到疾病的路径进行评分，并将每条路径归入五个病理轴之一，随后基于LLM的证据综合模块读取检索到的路径、试验记录和文献，生成经过校准的机制性论证，并进行最终的迭代重新排序。【结果】在一个涵盖淀粉样蛋白、tau、神经炎症、突触和代谢靶点的、包含1847个药物-疾病关联的精选基准上，RepurposeAD的前10命中率为0.83，精确率-召回率曲线下面积为0.79，受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.93，平均倒数排名为0.65，命中率和精确率-召回率面积分别比五个基线中最强者高0.07和0.08。排名最高的十个候选药物中有三个在与AD相关的适应证中有正在进行或已完成的试验。【结论】RepurposeAD提供了一条透明、可扩展且有机制依据的流程，可加速AD及相关痴呆的药物重新定位。

title: Calibrated Confidence and Confidence-Stratified Triage for Diabetic Retinopathy Severity Grading: A Class-Imbalance-Aware Deep Learning Study on the DDR Dataset.
zh_title: 糖尿病视网膜病变分级的校准置信度与分层分诊：DDR数据集研究
summary: 在12,522张DDR眼底照上，研究温度缩放与MC Dropout对EfficientNet-B0分级器可靠性的影响，并转化为自动放行/人工复核操作点。
key_points: 五折交叉验证，按近重复图像分组
评估总体与分级ECE
类别不平衡，重度NPDR仅1.9%
reason: 规范回顾性、样本较大，但仅公开数据集内部验证
abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Deep learning systems for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are usually reported through accuracy and area under the curve, yet clinical use depends on whether a model's confidence can be trusted. Problem: calibration and confidence-based triage are rarely evaluated on large, naturally imbalanced five-grade datasets. Objective: to quantify how temperature scaling and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout change the reliability of an EfficientNet-B0 DR grader and to convert calibrated confidence into auto-clear/human-review operating points. Materials: A total of 12,522 DDR fundus photographs on the five ICDR grades, only 1.9% of them severe non-proliferative DR. Methods: Methods included five-fold cross-validation grouped by near-duplicate images, with inner calibration splits; overall and per-grade expected calibration error (ECE); clustered bootstrap; comparison with other calibration maps, loss functions and backbones; Grad-CAM and LIME. Results: Macro-F1 was 0.705 (95% CI 0.691-0.718). Temperature scaling reduced ECE from 0.186 to 0.078 without changing any prediction, but grade-specific maps were needed to bring per-grade ECE below 0.01. Mutual information from MC-Dropout flagged errors better than confidence (AUROC 0.748 vs. 0.650). At a no-DR threshold of 0.80, 30.1% of images were auto-cleared with a 1.46% referable-DR false-clear rate. Conclusions: One temperature corrected most top-label miscalibration but not the grade-level error caused by class weighting; the triage thresholds need external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [生物工程（巴塞尔，瑞士）]【背景】用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的深度学习系统通常以准确率和曲线下面积来报告，但临床应用取决于模型的置信度是否可信。【问题】校准和基于置信度的分诊很少在大型、天然不平衡的五级数据集上得到评估。【目的】量化温度缩放和蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout如何改变 EfficientNet-B0 DR分级器的可靠性，并将校准后的置信度转化为自动清除/人工复核的操作点。【材料】共12,522张DDR眼底照片，按ICDR五级分级，其中重度非增殖性DR仅占1.9%。【方法】方法包括：按近重复图像分组的五折交叉验证，并设内部校准划分；总体及各分级的期望校准误差（ECE）；聚类自助法；与其他校准映射、损失函数和骨干网络的比较；以及 Grad-CAM 和 LIME。【结果】宏平均F1为0.705（95% CI 0.691-0.718）。温度缩放将ECE从0.186降至0.078，且不改变任何预测，但需要针对各分级的映射才能使各分级ECE降至0.01以下。MC-Dropout的互信息比置信度能更好地标记错误（AUROC 0.748对0.650）。在无DR阈值为0.80时，30.1%的图像被自动清除，可转诊DR的错误清除率为1.46%。【结论】单一温度参数可纠正大部分顶层标签的校准偏差，但无法纠正由类别加权造成的分级层面误差；分诊阈值在临床应用前需要外部验证。

title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Predicting Response and Outcomes After Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of ECG-Based Models.
zh_title: 基于心电图的机器学习预测心脏再同步治疗反应：系统综述与Meta分析
summary: 系统综述与Meta分析评估使用ECG信息的ML/DL模型预测CRT反应及结局的性能与方法学质量。
key_points: 背景：最多40%的CRT患者无明显改善
检索Scopus与Web of Science，2006至2026年4月
评估ECG为主的ML/DL预测模型
reason: 系统综述含Meta分析，主题为治疗反应预测，摘要未见结果数字
abstract: [Medical sciences (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Up to 40% of patients receiving cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) do not experience significant clinical improvement, highlighting the limitations of conventional selection criteria. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied to electrocardiogram (ECG) and other clinical data to improve patient selection. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the performance and methodological quality of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models using ECG-derived information to predict CRT response and clinical outcomes. Methods: A systematic literature search was conducted in Scopus and Web of Science for studies published between January 2006 and April 2026. Eligible studies developed or evaluated ML or DL algorithms primarily using pre-implantation ECG data to predict CRT response, including changes in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) or left ventricular end-systolic volume (LVESV), or mortality. Model performance and prognostic associations were synthesized using random-effects meta-analyses of the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and hazard ratios (HRs), respectively. Methodological quality and risk of bias were assessed using the PROBAST+AI tool. Results: We identified 14 eligible studies containing 34 distinct model evaluations. Most models utilized digital 12-lead ECG waveforms or single representative beats. Across 26 model-outcome estimates, the exploratory pooled AUROC was 0.710 (95% CI: 0.660-0.759), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 94.7%; p < 0.001). Across 10 heterogeneous model-outcome estimates, the exploratory pooled HR was 1.75 (95% CI: 1.42-2.15; I2 = 83.3%), although differences in prognostic constructs and endpoints precluded interpretation as a common effect. ML models had a higher pooled AUROC than DL models (0.752 vs. 0.669; exploratory Wald test: difference = 0.084; 95% CI: 0.002-0.165; p = 0.044). Pooled HR estimates also differed (ML: 2.22; DL: 1.46; ratio = 1.51; p < 0.001). These indirect subgroup comparisons were limited by clinical and methodological heterogeneity and potential dependence among estimates. PROBAST+AI assessment identified a high overall risk of bias in 32 of the 34 models, with concerns concentrated primarily in the participants and data sources and analysis domains. abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with a long preclinical phase, making early biomarker discovery essential for timely diagnosis, risk stratification, and intervention. Hearing loss has increasingly been recognized as a clinically important and potentially modifiable factor associated with cognitive decline and dementia risk. Beyond peripheral auditory impairment, accumulating evidence suggests that central auditory dysfunction, altered auditory processing, and electrophysiological abnormalities may emerge during the course of AD and related cognitive disorders. Auditory electrophysiological signals, including electroencephalography (EEG), auditory event-related potentials (ERP), auditory evoked cortical potentials (AECP), auditory brainstem response (ABR) recordings, cochlear microphonics (CM), and distortion product otoacoustic emission (DPOAE) measures, provide objective and repeatable measurements of peripheral and central auditory pathway function. However, conventional analysis based on peak latency, amplitude, spectral power, and manually engineered features may not fully capture subtle disease-related alterations distributed across time, frequency, and waveform morphology. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to extract high-dimensional and physiologically informative representations from auditory and neural signals. Machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), self-supervised learning (SSL), explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), and multimodal modeling can support data-driven biomarker discovery, especially in settings where labeled datasets are limited and electrophysiological changes are subtle. This critical narrative review synthesizes current knowledge at the intersection of hearing loss, AD, auditory electrophysiology, and AI. We discuss traditional signal processing, supervised ML, deep neural networks, self-supervised representation learning, explainable models, and multimodal integration strategies. We also identify major methodological limitations, including small sample sizes, heterogeneous acquisition protocols, insufficient external validation, limited interpretability, data leakage risks, and challenges in translating animal-model findings to human disease. Finally, we propose future directions for trustworthy, interpretable, and multimodal AI systems capable of advancing auditory electrophysiological biomarkers for AD and hearing-related neurodegeneration.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，具有较长的临床前期，因此早期生物标志物的发现对于及时诊断、风险分层和干预至关重要。听力损失日益被认为是与认知下降和痴呆风险相关的、具有重要临床意义且可能可干预的因素。除外周听觉损害外，越来越多的证据表明，中枢听觉功能障碍、听觉处理改变以及电生理异常可能在 AD 及相关认知障碍的病程中出现。听觉电生理信号，包括脑电图（EEG）、听觉事件相关电位（ERP）、听觉诱发皮层电位（AECP）、听性脑干反应（ABR）记录、耳蜗微音电位（CM）以及畸变产物耳声发射（DPOAE）测量，可对外周和中枢听觉通路功能提供客观且可重复的测量。然而，基于峰潜伏期、波幅、频谱功率及人工设计特征的传统分析，可能无法充分捕捉分布于时间、频率和波形形态中的细微疾病相关改变。人工智能（AI）为从听觉和神经信号中提取高维且具有生理学信息的表征提供了新的机会。机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）、自监督学习（SSL）、可解释人工智能（XAI）和多模态建模可支持数据驱动的生物标志物发现，尤其是在标注数据集有限且电生理变化细微的情况下。本篇批判性叙述性综述综合了听力损失、AD、听觉电生理学与 AI 交叉领域的现有知识。我们讨论了传统信号处理、监督式机器学习、深度神经网络、自监督表征学习、可解释模型以及多模态整合策略。我们还指出了主要的方法学局限，包括样本量小、采集方案异质、外部验证不足、可解释性有限、数据泄漏风险，以及将动物模型研究结果转化到人类疾病所面临的挑战。最后，我们提出了未来的发展方向，即构建可信、可解释的多模态 AI 系统，以推进用于 AD 及听力相关神经退行性变的听觉电生理生物标志物。

abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] Non-real-time monitoring in diabetic wound infections often leads to treatment delays, exacerbating tissue damage and impairing healing. Herein, this study develops a deep learning-assisted covalent organic framework (COF)-based wound management platform for point-of-care pH monitoring and photothermal therapy. The platform is constructed using a multifunctional hydrogel, covalently incorporating methacrylated phenol red (MA-PR) for stable pH colorimetric sensing and integrating metal-free COF-102 as a photothermal therapeutic unit. Benefiting from its extended π-π conjugated framework and low thermal conductivity, COF-102 achieves efficient photothermal conversion without the need for metal ions or additional photothermal agents, thereby enhancing the biosafety of the system. Furthermore, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is introduced to analyze hydrogel color images, enabling accurate classification of wound status and supporting near-infrared photothermal intervention. The model is deployed on a mobile web application, facilitating convenient point-of-care analysis. In an infected wound animal model, the platform shows good therapeutic performance, reduces unnecessary heat exposure, and significantly promotes wound healing. Overall, this study establishes a point-of-care wound management strategy for photothermal therapy of chronic wounds.

abstract: [Bioethics] It has recently been proposed that fine-tuned large-language models (LLMs) could more accurately predict the preferences of incapacitated patients than surrogates. This hypothetical technology has been named the personalised patient preference predictor (P4). Advocates of the P4 claim that the P4 will not only more accurately predict patient preferences, but will better respect patient autonomy, facilitate the composition of advance directives, and reduce the emotional burden of surrogate decision-making. I challenge these purported benefits by arguing that the P4 would pose a substantive risk to our ability to meaningfully grapple with death. Drawing on the philosophies of Søren Kierkegaard and Martin Heidegger, I argue that adopting an existential attitude towards death is central to the pursuit of an ethical life. Implementation of the P4 risks inhibiting both patients and surrogates from adopting an existential attitude towards death, with deleterious consequences.
zh_abstract: [Bioethics] 最近有人提出，经过微调的大语言模型（LLM）可能比代理决策者更准确地预测失去行为能力患者的偏好。这一假想技术被称为个性化患者偏好预测器（personalised patient preference predictor，P4）。P4 的支持者声称，P4 不仅能更准确地预测患者偏好，还能更好地尊重患者自主权、便于预先指示的制定，并减轻代理决策的情感负担。我对这些所谓的益处提出质疑，认为 P4 会对我们切实面对死亡的能力构成实质性风险。借助索伦·克尔凯郭尔（Søren Kierkegaard）和马丁·海德格尔（Martin Heidegger）的哲学，我认为对死亡采取一种存在论态度是追求伦理生活的核心。P4 的应用可能会妨碍患者和代理决策者对死亡采取存在论态度，并带来有害后果。

abstract: [Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine] Congenital anomalies affect approximately 3 to 5% of all pregnancies and represent a leading cause of infant morbidity and mortality worldwide. When a fetal malformation is detected on mid-trimester anatomic ultrasound, the clinical encounter that follows is not merely a medical consultation. It is an ethically charged event requiring the clinician to simultaneously respect maternal autonomy, apply beneficence-based clinical judgment, and, after viability, fulfill obligations to the fetal patient as well. This article applies the professional responsibility model, grounded in the ethics of medicine as a profession developed by John Gregory and Thomas Percival, to the counseling process following prenatal detection of a fetal anomaly. The model requires physicians to maintain scientific and clinical competence, to place the health-related interests of both patients as their primary concern, and to preserve medicine as a public trust. Within this framework, autonomy, beneficence, and justice each impose specific obligations, and a preventive ethics approach demands that clinicians anticipate and address ethical conflict before it escalates. Large language models (LLMs) offer genuine capabilities to support these ethical obligations: personalizing diagnostic information, bridging language and health literacy barriers, and extending clinical support beyond the encounter itself. However, LLM-generated content should be clinician-reviewed before reaching patients, informed consent processes should disclose AI involvement, and implementation should actively address equity across care settings. The physician's role as guide, interpreter, and compassionate presence cannot be delegated to any algorithmic system. With appropriate governance, LLMs amplify the art of counseling rather than replace it.
zh_abstract: [胎儿与新生儿医学研讨(Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine)] 先天性异常影响约3%至5%的妊娠，是全球婴儿发病和死亡的主要原因之一。当孕中期解剖学超声发现胎儿畸形时，随后的临床接触不仅仅是一次医学咨询，而是一个带有伦理张力的事件，要求临床医生在尊重孕妇自主权、运用基于有利原则的临床判断的同时，在胎儿具备存活能力之后还要履行对胎儿患者的义务。本文将以John Gregory和Thomas Percival所发展的医学职业伦理为基础的职业责任模型，应用于产前发现胎儿异常后的咨询过程。该模型要求医生保持科学与临床能力，将两位患者与健康相关的利益作为首要关切，并维护医学作为公共信托的地位。在这一框架下，自主、有利和公正各自施加具体的义务，而预防性伦理方法要求临床医生在伦理冲突升级之前预见并加以处理。大语言模型(LLMs)为支持这些伦理义务提供了切实的能力：个性化诊断信息、跨越语言和健康素养障碍，以及将临床支持延伸至诊疗接触之外。然而，LLM生成的内容在送达患者之前应经临床医生审核，知情同意过程应披露人工智能的参与，且实施过程应积极解决不同医疗环境之间的公平问题。医生作为引导者、解释者和富有同情心的陪伴者的角色，不能委托给任何算法系统。在适当的治理下，LLMs能够增强而非取代咨询这门艺术。

abstract: [Sheng wu gong cheng xue bao = Chinese journal of biotechnology] Synthetic biology aims to design, modify, or synthesize new biological parts, genetic networks, and metabolic pathways from the bottom up, and even to create artificial cells with specific functions, offering transformative solutions in medicine, chemical engineering, energy, and other fields. In constructing complex biological systems, the underlying biological parts serve as the core basic components. Conventional methods for obtaining parts rely mainly on mining and characterizing natural organisms, which are not only time-consuming and labor-intensive but also depend on lengthy empirical trial-and-error, making it difficult to meet diverse industrial demands. Using artificial intelligence (AI) to study parts enables the precise mining of implicit mapping relationships between massive biological sequences and their functions, thereby allowing efficient prediction of part expression levels and breaking through the constraints of natural species to design de novo high-activity parts that do not exist in nature. Building upon this, this paper systematically reviews the latest advances in the AI-assisted design of biological parts for microbial chassis. It first outlines the advantages of underlying AI algorithms in feature extraction and generation of biological sequences. Then, it details the specific applications and breakthroughs of AI technologies in engineering and de novo designing two core categories-transcriptional regulatory parts and translational regulatory parts-across different chassis cells. Finally, the article discusses the current challenges, such as data sparsity and weak cross-species generalization, in AI design and provides an outlook on a new blueprint for efficient part development that integrates physics-based models, large language models, and fully automated laboratories in the future. This review provides theoretical references for accelerating the rational design of biological parts and advancing the intelligent and industrial development of synthetic biology.
zh_abstract: [生物工程学报] 合成生物学旨在自下而上地设计、改造或合成新的生物元件、基因网络和代谢途径，甚至创造具有特定功能的人工细胞，为医学、化工、能源等领域提供变革性的解决方案。在构建复杂生物系统时，底层生物元件是核心基础组件。获取元件的传统方法主要依赖对天然生物的挖掘与表征，不仅耗时费力，而且依赖冗长的经验性试错，难以满足多样化的工业需求。利用人工智能（AI）研究元件，能够精准挖掘海量生物序列与其功能之间隐含的映射关系，从而高效预测元件表达水平，并突破天然物种的限制，从头设计自然界中不存在的高活性元件。在此基础上，本文系统综述了AI辅助微生物底盘生物元件设计的最新进展。首先概述了底层AI算法在生物序列特征提取和生成方面的优势；然后详述了AI技术在不同底盘细胞中对转录调控元件和翻译调控元件这两类核心元件进行工程改造和从头设计的具体应用与突破；最后讨论了AI设计目前面临的数据稀疏、跨物种泛化能力弱等挑战，并展望了未来整合基于物理的模型、大语言模型和全自动实验室的高效元件开发新蓝图。本综述为加速生物元件的理性设计、推动合成生物学的智能化和产业化发展提供了理论参考。

abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] Generative and predictive artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly increasing the number of molecular, structural, cellular, and therapeutic hypotheses that can be explored computationally. Experimental capacity, however, has not expanded at a comparable rate. The result is an evidence bottleneck, in which biological hypotheses are generated faster than they can be experimentally tested, reproduced, and translated. This mismatch is particularly consequential for pharmaceutical discovery, where computational predictions alone cannot establish biological function, mechanism, or therapeutic value. As the number of computationally generated hypotheses grows, the central challenge shifts from candidate generation to the prioritization of hypotheses for experimental validation. This evidence bottleneck represents a defining constraint of AI-enabled biological discovery. We examine how different biological claims, including structural, interaction, functional, mechanistic, and therapeutic claims, require distinct types and levels of evidence. We also address the cost and context-dependence of experimental validation. Furthermore, we discuss how information-guided experimental design and iterative model-experiment feedback can improve the allocation of limited experimental capacity. We propose an evidence-centric framework for drug discovery that extends the evaluation of generative models beyond their ability to generate or rank hypotheses. The framework emphasizes experimental testability, mechanistic understanding, reproducibility, and translation into actionable biological and therapeutic knowledge.
zh_abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] 生成式和预测性人工智能（AI）正迅速增加可通过计算探索的分子、结构、细胞及治疗假说的数量。然而，实验能力的扩展速度并未与之相当。其结果是形成证据瓶颈，即生物学假说的产生速度快于其被实验检验、重复和转化的速度。这种不匹配对药物发现尤为重要，因为仅凭计算预测无法确立生物学功能、机制或治疗价值。随着计算生成的假说数量增加，核心挑战从候选假说的生成转向对假说进行优先排序以供实验验证。这一证据瓶颈是AI赋能的生物学发现的决定性制约因素。我们探讨了不同的生物学主张（包括结构、相互作用、功能、机制和治疗方面的主张）如何需要不同类型和水平的证据。我们还讨论了实验验证的成本及其对情境的依赖性。此外，我们讨论了以信息为导向的实验设计以及模型–实验的迭代反馈如何改善有限实验能力的分配。我们提出了一个以证据为中心的药物发现框架，将对生成模型的评价扩展到其生成或排序假说的能力之外。该框架强调实验可检验性、机制理解、可重复性，以及向可付诸行动的生物学和治疗知识的转化。

abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)] Background and Objectives: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of preventable vision loss. Staging based on colour fundus photography captures only part of a disease that involves the whole neurovascular unit and the retinal periphery. This narrative review summarizes the structural (optical coherence tomography, OCT), vascular (OCT angiography and ultra-widefield imaging) and functional (microperimetry, electrophysiology) biomarkers of DR, grades the evidence supporting each of them, and examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing screening, prognostication and treatment selection. Materials and Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Web of Science were searched for publications from January 2000 to May 2026, giving priority to randomized trials, prospective multicentre cohorts, systematic reviews and externally validated algorithms. Results: Among imaging biomarkers, disorganization of the retinal inner layers, outer retinal integrity and ultra-widefield angiographic non-perfusion have the most consistent prognostic evidence, whereas OCT angiography metrics remain device-dependent. AI has progressed from research classifiers to autonomous systems with regulatory authorization in the United States and the European Union, to prospectively evaluated deployments in national programmes and low-resource settings, and to time-to-event progression models and foundation models. Image-based prediction improves discrimination over clinical risk factors by modest margins, and biomarker-guided treatment of diabetic macular oedema still rests largely on retrospective series. Cross-device standardization of quantitative metrics, representative datasets, prospective outcome trials and health-economic evidence remain the main gaps. Conclusions: Individualized screening intervals are the application closest to routine practice, whereas phenotype-driven therapy and precision monitoring remain promising but unproven.
zh_abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)]【背景和目的】糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）仍是可预防性视力丧失的主要原因。基于彩色眼底照相的分期只能反映这种累及整个神经血管单元及视网膜周边部的疾病的一部分。本叙述性综述总结了DR的结构性（光学相干断层扫描，OCT）、血管性（OCT血管成像和超广角成像）和功能性（微视野检查、电生理）生物标志物，对支持每种标志物的证据进行分级，并探讨人工智能（AI）如何改变筛查、预后判断和治疗选择。【材料和方法】检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中2000年1月至2026年5月的文献，优先纳入随机试验、前瞻性多中心队列、系统综述和经过外部验证的算法。【结果】在影像学生物标志物中，视网膜内层结构紊乱、视网膜外层完整性以及超广角血管造影显示的无灌注区具有最一致的预后证据，而OCT血管成像指标仍依赖于设备。AI已从研究性分类器发展为在美国和欧盟获得监管批准的自主系统，发展为在国家项目和资源匮乏环境中经过前瞻性评估的部署，并进一步发展为事件时间进展模型和基础模型。与临床危险因素相比，基于图像的预测对区分能力的提升幅度有限，而针对糖尿病性黄斑水肿的生物标志物指导治疗仍主要依赖回顾性系列研究。定量指标的跨设备标准化、具有代表性的数据集、前瞻性结局试验和卫生经济学证据仍是主要缺口。【结论】个体化筛查间隔是最接近常规实践的应用，而表型驱动的治疗和精准监测仍具前景但尚未得到证实。

abstract: [Biomimetics (Basel, Switzerland)] Accurate trajectory tracking is essential for autonomous dental scanning in the presence of patient-specific anatomical variations and robotic nonidealities. This study proposes a patient-specific trajectory-tracking framework for the four-DOF Dentatron dental robot using a deep learning residual controller. Ten patient-specific maxillary geometries were extracted and parameterized from upper-jaw intraoral scans obtained from the publicly available Teeth3DS+ dataset. The selected cases represented variations in intercanine width, intermolar width, total arch length, palatal depth, arch form, crowding, spacing, and asymmetry. Sixteen scanning targets were defined for each patient-derived geometry and converted into smooth Cartesian trajectories sampled at 100 Hz, resulting in a dataset of 31,000 trajectory samples. A MATLAB/Simulink-Simscape model of the Dentatron was developed incorporating representative robotic and sensing nonidealities, including joint dynamics, mechanical backlash, an 80 ms command delay, disturbances, encoder quantization, measurement noise, and sensor bias. The residual controller estimates joint-position and joint-speed corrections using patient-specific geometric descriptors, trajectory variables, and robot-state information. Patient-wise partitioning was employed to evaluate generalization to complete maxillary geometries excluded from model training. On the unseen test set, the overall joint-position RMSE decreased from approximately 0.34° to 0.26°, corresponding to a 22.7% improvement, while joint-speed RMSE decreased from approximately 1.25°/s to 0.96°/s, representing a 23.0% improvement. The strongest compensation was observed for joints with the largest baseline tracking errors, particularly J2 and J3, whereas smaller improvements were obtained for joints with lower initial errors. All generated patient-specific trajectories remained outside the adopted singularity region. These results demonstrate the feasibility of residual deep learning for improving patient-specific Dentatron trajectory tracking under simulated robotic nonidealities while maintaining kinematic feasibility.
